question: A conducting rod of mass $m$ and length $l$ can slide without friction on two parallel horizontal rails. The rails and rod form a closed circuit. A uniform magnetic field is perpendicular to the plane of the rails (into the page). A capacitor of capacitance $C$ is initially charged to potential $V_0$ and is connected across the rails through a switch. The switch is closed at $t=0$. Assume the capacitor fully discharges so that after a long time the current becomes zero. Find the final speed of the rod.
